source.commitRole: base revision before compiling the dirty worktree; this commit alone does not reproduce the measured decoder

electronLaunch.mode: directly launched repository-local Electron executable; bypassed require('electron') launcher

fixture.content: deterministic high-entropy synthetic baseline JPEG; APP2 segments bring the source within 3 bytes of 20 MiB; no user data

worker.recyclingPolicy: one fresh process per uncached image larger than the 32 MiB decoded cache

jpegCapacityEstimate.includes: encoded input copies, coefficient blocks, component lines, RGB intermediate, RGBA output, JPEG tables, Huffman trees, and decoded comments

latency.timingScope: fresh utility process ready, then request post through decompressed 64,000,000-byte RGBA response receipt
latency.responsePayloadBytesMeaning: Compressed IPC transport payload bytes (transportBytes), not the 64,000,000-byte decompressed RGBA response.
latency.pixelOracle: none; only output dimensions, byte length, and alpha at three sample positions were checked; no full-pixel comparison, hash, or independent RGB oracle was used

limitations: Fresh-process synthetic 16MP samples are diagnostic; they do not satisfy the T05 100-sample controlled desktop timing gates or measure end-user paste latency.

The JPEG is a generated baseline image with synthetic APP2 padding to exercise the encoded-source ceiling; progressive JPEG, real EXIF/ICC metadata, other image content, UI responsiveness and original clipboard conversion are not covered.
No fixture was rejected by the decoder's internal capacity guard in this sample set; this does not establish a universal process-memory ceiling.

PeakWorkingSet64 is the OS-reported peak for each fresh process; private bytes are sampled every 100 ms and around each decode, so shorter private-memory peaks can be missed. These observations do not prove a hard ceiling for every decode.
No clipboard, target window, physical input, installed package, helper, or rollback behavior was exercised. P15 and full T04 acceptance remain open.

Electron used the default %APPDATA%\Electron userData directory; profile isolation was not configured and possible profile side effects were not checked. Do not interpret the synthetic JPEG fixture's 'no user data' description as an isolated application profile.
No independent pixel correctness oracle was run; this diagnostic establishes successful full-size response shape only, not decoded color correctness.
The measured executable was built from the dirty worktree identified by source.workingTreeFiles and source.builtArtifactFiles; the full launch argument vector was not retained.
